findings.summary: Frozen rows include variant-group/category contamination; Toast featured repeats and modifiers were removed. Current menu adds distinct food/brunch products.
Official allergen disclosure is accurately unavailable; direct exact-name positives are retained only where menu text names fish, crab, cheese, cream, or egg.

proposedChanges: Replace generated catalog with the 48 distinct current food/nonalcoholic products represented by the complete linked Toast menu plus current official brunch surface.
Remove featured duplicates, modifiers, modifier allergy labels, category headings, alcohol-only items, and empty support sections.
Preserve direct named fish, shellfish, milk, and egg positives only; leave all other direct allergen fields unavailable.
